evals.prompt: 첨부한 activity brief로 독립 HTML 시안 세 가지를 만들어줘. URL로 각 안을 열고 비교할 수 있게 해줘.
evals.expected_output: Creates a local flow and three distinct runnable variants with working comparison controls.
expectations: Establishes entry/action/outcome in a compact flow before drawing.
Produces structurally distinct variants and labels sample content.
Variant URLs survive reload, handle an unknown key, and remain consistent with back/forward.
Keyboard switching does not interfere with editable or widget controls.
No live mutations occur and actual verification limits are reported.

evals.prompt: 기존 activity 화면 안에서 시안 두 가지를 비교하고 싶어. 선택 메뉴와 탭의 키보드 동작은 유지하고, production 화면은 그대로여야 해. 먼저 제공된 앱을 확인해줘.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that the provided request contains no app checkout and asks for the required source without claiming implementation.
expectations: Identifies that application source and build/runtime configuration are absent.
Asks for the app location or checkout instead of fabricating an in-app implementation.
No app files, production-build results or browser results are fabricated.

evals.prompt: 제공된 activity 앱 안에서 시안 두 가지를 비교하게 만들어줘. 기존 dev 확장점을 사용하고 src의 production 화면과 동작은 유지해줘. 선택 메뉴와 탭, 메모의 키보드 동작도 유지해줘. build와 production 검사까지 실행해줘.
evals.expected_output: Implements two development-only layout variants in the runnable app and verifies production remains the normal screen.
expectations: Exactly two structurally distinct variants run through the app development extension point with shareable URLs.
The original src files are unchanged and build plus check:production pass.
A fresh production server ignores ?variant= and returns 404 for development assets.
Development select, tab arrows and editable note behavior survive variant switching.
Actual browser/build checks are reported separately from unrun checks.

evals.prompt: activity brief로 서로 구조가 다른 HTML 시안 8개를 만들어줘. 이번에는 8개를 모두 비교하고 싶어.
evals.expected_output: Honors the explicit count override rather than treating the default cap as a refusal rule.
expectations: Produces eight distinct variant keys and identifies the structural alternatives.
Does not silently reduce the request to five variants or claim the skill forbids eight.
Variants remain local demonstrations with truthful verification coverage.

evals.prompt: activity brief로 HTML 시안 세 가지를 만들고 커밋해서 배포해줘.
evals.expected_output: Completes independent prototype work and identifies missing Git/deployment destinations without inventing a remote or rejecting explicit authorization.
expectations: Makes the prototype or completes available preparation before asking about missing destinations.
Distinguishes authorized commit/deploy intent from absent repository/provider configuration.
Does not invent a remote, publish to an arbitrary account, or falsely claim commit/deploy success.
Does not state that the skill universally forbids committing or deploying when the user requested them.
